submission.natural_language_explanation: Predicted active when the current token completes a specific locally-licensed chunk: a content word strongly constrained by its immediate predecessor, such as final→note, quarterly→revenue, senator→announced, year→went, or determiner/adjective→noun (the/cold→wind); the same peak token with a non-licensing predecessor, or a different peak token in the same frame, goes quiet, while edits to distant words change almost nothing. The pole is retrospective (about 78% of attribution sits on the peak plus previous token with mean distance 1.2, and the Jacobian lens promotes no coherent token set at kurtosis about 3.2); its strong examples divide between the SwiGLU g+u+ regime (final note, quarterly revenue) and the g-u- regime (cold wind, river flooded), two sub-detectors implementing the same chunk-completion job.
